org.tagline: A creative association supporting children and teenagers in their creative work.

hero.subtitle: Auditions, studios, exhibitions and festivals. We work so that every child finds their own voice, their own colour and their own stage.

flagship.heading: UPOP TREND
flagship.lead: Singing auditions held right across the country. One route from the regional rounds to the stage in the capital: voice, coaching, live performance.

projects.heading: Our projects
projects.lead: Four directions, four different kinds of work. Each has its own stage, its own mentors and its own colour.

about.heading: About us
about.p1: The association gives children and teenagers a place to do creative work, a mentor and a stage. Classes are free and the competitions are open to everyone.
about.p2: We work from regional centres out to small districts: we open studios, train teachers, and run exhibitions and festivals.
about.p3: A child shows a different side of themselves once they come to creative work. Our job is not to leave them on their own at that moment.

people.heading: Expert Council
people.lead: The specialists who judge the competitions and approve the programmes.

partners.heading: Partners
partners.lead: Our projects are run together with state bodies, educational institutions and private organisations.

closing.heading: Start creating with us
closing.lead: Leave a request and we will write back about the nearest studio, the competition dates and the next step.

about.title: About us
about.lead: The Children’s Creativity Association was set up to bring out the creative ability of children and teenagers.
about.missionBody: Every child should have the chance to do creative work. That takes a studio nearby, a trained mentor and a real stage. We bring those three together in one place.
about.historyBody1: The association grew out of a joint exhibition by several city studios. It became clear then that there were plenty of children and plenty of mentors, but nothing to join them up.
about.historyBody2: Today the association works in four directions and reaches several thousand children a year. The largest of them is the UPOP TREND audition.

values.openBody: No papers, references or fees are needed to enter a competition. An application and taking part are enough.
values.craftBody: Judging a child is easy, teaching one is hard. We put our time into training teachers.
values.stageBody: A drawing should reach the wall and a song should reach the stage. Otherwise the work is only half done.
values.regionBody: Outside the capital, the same programme, the same mentors and the same chances.

legal.privacyLead: This page sets out what the site collects and why it is needed.
legal.collectBody: Only what you type into the contact form: your name, email address, phone number (if you give one), the subject and the message itself. The site asks for nothing else.
legal.useBody: One purpose only — replying to your message. It is never used for advertising and never passed on to anyone else.
legal.storeBody: A message sent through the form goes to the association’s internal channel. The site itself has no database, so nothing is stored here.
legal.cookiesBody: One cookie remembers the language you chose. The light or dark setting is kept in your own browser and is never sent to the server. There is no analytics and no advertising tracking of any kind.
legal.rightsBody: To have your correspondence deleted, write to the email address below. We take care of it within a few working days.
